Patch Set 48:

(3 comments)

The fact that we've also now needed to invent an "override" in addition to the include system somewhat proves my point that we're making these more complex than they need to be.

If theres a common battery scheme we can include, just invent a new type called "Battery" and implement the thresholds in code.

> needed to invent an "override" in addition to the include system

This is just the notation to make it easier to read.
If you have any constructive idea about the notation, i am happy to consider 😊


> If theres a common battery scheme we can include, just invent a new type called "Battery" and implement the thresholds in code.

Implementing thresholds in code is not possible in all cases. Depending on the hardware design and intended application, even a single component will run with different thresholds in different systems. Same story for ```PowerState``` and other properties.

> If you have any constructive idea about the notation, i am happy to consider 😊

Telling me to limit my feedback only to the thing you've proposed is a little offputting, which is why i didn't reply right away.  The goal here is a system that  works well, not a couple config files that are easy to read.  At a system level, i don't see where these fix in between code modification, bind expressions, and explicitly stating each thing.  If this is something you want to continue with, that would be my constructive advise, define the need in terms other than deduplicating the config.

I find it somewhat hard to believe that a config like this is truly shared.

It looks like it should've been another entity?
This file got reordered?
